rows: The instrument that detects and records ground motion.
The resulting graph or output produced by the recording device.

items: Distinguish clearly between Seismograph (the measuring device) and Seismogram (the recorded output graph).
Understand that the epicenter distance is determined using the time gap between P and S waves.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A seismograph is the instrument used to measure and record ground motion caused by seismic waves.
A seismogram is the visual graph or data recording produced by a seismograph.
The time interval between the arrival of P (Primary) waves and S (Secondary) waves is crucial for calculating the distance to an earthquake's epicenter.
